thag8.3:1.1: Yadā paṭhamam addakkhiṃ satthāraṃ akutobhayaṃ, tato me ahu saṃvego passitvā purisuttamaṃ. || ||
thag8.3:2.1: siriṃ hatthehi pādehi yo paṇāmeyya āgataṃ, etādisaṃ so satthāraṃ ārādhetvā virādhaye. || ||
thag8.3:3.1: tadāhaṃ puttadārañ ca dhanadhaññañ ca chaḍḍayiṃ, kesamassūni chedetvā pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ. || ||
thag8.3:4.1: sikkhāsājīvasampanno indriyesu susaṃvuto namassamāno sambuddhaṃ vihāsiṃ aparājito. || ||
thag8.3:5.1: tato me paṇidhī āsi cetaso abhipatthito: na nisīde muhuttam pi taṇhāsalle anūhate. || ||
thag8.3:6.1: tassa mevaṃ viharato passa viriyaparakkamaṃ, tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ. || ||
thag8.3:7.1: pubbenivāsaṃ jānāmi, dibbacakkhuṃ visodhitaṃ, arahā dakkhiṇeyyo 'mhi vippamutto nirūpadhi. || ||
thag8.3:8.1: tato ratyā vivasane suriyass' uggamanaṃ pati sabbaṃ taṇhaṃ visosetva pallaṅkena upāvisin ti. || || Mahāpanthako thero. uddānaṃ: Mahākaccāyano thero
thag8.3:9.0: Sirimitto Mahāpanthako ete Aṭṭhanipātamhi, gāthāyo catuvīsatīti.
